title: Shopify Product Detail Page (PDP) Conversion Rate Optimization & Audit
summary: Comprehensive before-and-after conversion rate optimization (CRO) audit and redesign for Shopify OS 2.0 product pages, implementing mobile sticky buy boxes, trust architecture, dynamic tier bundles, and metafield accordion blocks.
problem: E-commerce store operators drive expensive paid traffic from Meta and Google Ads directly to default Shopify product pages, suffering from high mobile bounce rates (58%+), clunky variant dropdowns, zero social proof above the fold, and buried add-to-cart buttons that kill mobile conversion velocity.
whatIDid: Conducted a 25-point heuristic CRO audit evaluating Above-The-Fold hierarchy, decision friction, trust architecture, and mobile responsive behavior.
Engineered a high-contrast floating sticky mobile Add-to-Cart bar with real-time price updates ensuring shoppers never lose access to the buy action while scrolling.
Replaced default unformatted HTML descriptions with Shopify OS 2.0 native collapsible accordion tabs connected to product metafields for technical specifications and care guides.
Integrated star rating badges with anchor jump links to verified customer review galleries directly above the product title.
Designed a tiered volume discount module ('Buy 2 Save 10%') directly inside the buy box to boost Average Order Value (AOV) on impulse and gifting purchases.
Structured a 3-point risk-reversal trust badge cluster (30-day trial, carbon-neutral delivery, SSL security) directly beneath the primary checkout button.
result: Modeled conversion performance metrics showing a +57.8% lift in checkout conversion rate (1.85% to 2.92%), a +67.3% surge in mobile add-to-cart interactions, and a +$10.70 expansion in Average Order Value (AOV).
